misclassified_entities.reason: Transaction execution is an internal process triggered by external submission. The transaction object itself is the external input, but 'execution' is internal system behavior.

trusted_external_entities.name: Block Producer (Miner)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Miners are network participants producing blocks. Blocks must pass full consensus validation including PoW, difficulty, and transaction validity. No inherent trust.

trusted_external_entities.name: Replay Attacker
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Explicitly malicious actor attempting to replay transactions from other chains (e.g., ETC). This is a threat model entity - all input treated as adversarial.

trusted_external_entities.name: Legitimate User
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Users submit signed transactions. Despite being 'legitimate', transaction signatures must still be verified and chain ID validated. User input is never trusted.

trusted_external_entities.name: Network Peer
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Anonymous P2P peer submitting blocks for validation. Blocks must be fully validated including header, ommers, transactions, and root hashes. No trust in peer data.

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Sender
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External account submitting transactions. Signature recovery authenticates sender identity, but transaction content (gas, value, data) must still be validated.

trusted_external_entities.name: Block Miner
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Miner that produced a block with proof-of-work. PoW proves computational effort but does not imply trust. Block content must be independently validated.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Block header must trigger correct fork activation check. Invalid block numbers or headers are rejected through consensus validation.
Replay attack protection via EIP-155 chain ID verification. Transactions signed for other chains must be rejected.
Transaction signature must be valid, chain ID must match, and sender must have sufficient balance for gas and value.
Note: EXT-TRANSACTION is misclassified. Account addresses accessed during execution are validated through normal EVM execution.
Block from peer must pass complete validation pipeline: header validation, ommer validation, transaction execution, and root hash verification.

coverage_gaps.reason: EXT-MINER is referenced in Byzantium consensus subgraph but no explicit incoming boundary edge - mining is internal block production, not external input
